dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Claude Opus 4.7 achieved an end-to-end score of 0.82 on the first long-form virology task and 0.94 on the second long-form virology task
dc_eval_cbrn.locator: 2.2.5.2 Automated evaluations relevant to the CB-1 threat model
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Scores for this model on virology tasks plus expert red teaming and CB-1/CB-2 determinations.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Claude Opus 4.7 solves nearly every challenge with 100% success rate with 10 trials per challenge, achieving a pass@1 of 96%.
dc_eval_cyber.note: Cybench, CyberGym, Firefox 147 and UK AISI cyber range results reported for this model.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Claude Opus 4.7 clears the 4h and 8h thresholds on all tasks, and the 40h threshold on 2 out of 3 tasks.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D task results (kernel, LLM training, etc.) with threshold determination for automated R&D.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: The helpful-only version of Claude Opus 4.7 showed a higher success rate than Claude Opus 4.6 on both tasks, and scored higher than Claude Mythos Preview on the domestic polarization scenario.
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Influence-operation/harmful manipulation eval with task completion rates (57.1%, 46.8%) for this model.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Under the realistic Extended Thinking conditions, Claude Opus 4.7's stealth rate is 1.5–2.0%
dc_eval_scheming.note: SHADE-Arena sabotage stealth rates, sandbagging review, evaluation-awareness and reward-hacking results for this model.

framework_threshold.quote: We assess that Claude Opus 4.7 does not cross the automated AI-R&D capability threshold.
framework_threshold.note: RSP: places this model against AI R&D threshold, CB-1/CB-2 thresholds, ASL-3-equivalent protections.

ext_test_any.quote: We are very grateful to a number of external testers for running pre-deployment assessments of Claude Opus 4.7.
ext_test_any.note: External testers named generically; also UK AISI, Gray Swan, expert red teamers.

ext_test_named_org.quote: We shared a pre-release snapshot of Claude Opus 4.7 with the UK AI Security Institute (UK AISI) for open-ended testing
ext_test_named_org.locator: 3.4 External testing from the UK AI Security Institute
ext_test_named_org.note: UK AISI named; Gray Swan also named (5.2.1).

ext_test_government.quote: We shared a pre-release snapshot of Claude Opus 4.7 with the UK AI Security Institute (UK AISI) for open-ended testing
ext_test_government.locator: 3.4 External testing from the UK AI Security Institute
ext_test_government.note: UK AISI tested pre-release snapshot (cyber and misalignment, 6.2.4).

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: We are very grateful to a number of external testers for running pre-deployment assessments of Claude Opus 4.7.
ext_test_timing_stated.note: Card states pre-deployment and pre-release outside testing.

safeguards_training.quote: The fully-trained versions of these models have additional harmlessness training.
safeguards_training.note: Harmlessness training stated for the final model; also constitution-aligned post-training (1.1.1).

safeguards_runtime.quote: we will apply strong real-time classifier guards to this model and access controls for classifier guard exemptions.
safeguards_runtime.note: Real-time classifier guards; also cyber probe-based classifiers (3.2) and chemical monitoring (2.2.3).

safeguards_access.quote: Cybersecurity practitioners who have appropriate dual use cases and who are nonetheless experiencing blocks from these probes can apply for exemptions
safeguards_access.note: Exemption access programme tied to cyber misuse risk; access controls for classifier guard exemptions (2.1.2.2).

safeguards_weights.quote: a variety of rapid response options for jailbreaks; and security controls to reduce risk of model weight theft.
safeguards_weights.note: Security controls against weight theft listed among mitigations applied with this release.
